resources.string: App lock & privacy
Discreet notifications
Notifications say \"Bill due\" or \"Budget alert\" instead of amounts, merchants and product names. Also applies to smartwatches and car displays.
Shown as discreet until the setting can be read.
Checking…
Can\'t read your privacy settings. Notifications are shown as discreet until the settings can be read.
Try again
Review your privacy settings
The app couldn\'t read your saved privacy settings, so it is using the safest options. Choose your settings below, then save.
Save settings
Settings saved
Couldn\'t save the setting. Try again.
App lock
Ask for your fingerprint or screen lock when the app opens.
Waiting for confirmation…
App lock needs Android 11 or newer. This device runs an older version.
App lock isn\'t supported on this Android version, so it is paused. Turn it off to remove this notice.
Set a PIN, pattern or password as your phone\'s screen lock to use app lock.
App lock isn\'t available right now. Try again in a moment.
Open security settings
Can\'t read the app lock setting. If your phone has a screen lock, the app will ask you to unlock it.
Always on while app lock is on.
App lock is paused, so Off is the only choice.
Turn on app lock?
The app asks for your fingerprint or screen lock when it opens, and after you leave it for the time you choose.
Notifications show no amounts or details while app lock is on.
Notifications already showing are replaced with the private version.
Screenshots and screen recording are blocked and the app\'s content is hidden in recent apps.
Reminders and automatic capture keep working while the app is locked.
Only your screen lock or a strong biometric, like your fingerprint, can unlock the app. Basic face unlock isn\'t used.
Bill reminders won\'t show Snooze or Dismiss while app lock is on.
Continue
App lock is on
App lock is off
App lock was not turned on.
Couldn\'t turn on app lock. Try again.
On Android 11, bill reminders don\'t show Snooze or Dismiss while app lock is on.
Lock after leaving the app
When App lock is on, the app always locks when it starts fresh.
Immediately
After 30 seconds
After 1 minute
After 5 minutes
After 15 minutes
Locks as soon as you leave the app, including after the camera or a file picker. Choose a longer time if you attach photos or receipts often.
Locks if the camera or a file picker takes longer than this.
App lock is paused, so you can only choose a shorter time or keep the current one.
Secure screen
Hides the app\'s content in recent apps and blocks screenshots, screen recording and casting.
Always on while app lock is on. You won\'t be able to take screenshots of your own reports.
Anyone who knows your phone\'s screen lock can unlock the app. Apps with accessibility access can still read the screen.
